name: Loan intake checklist
summary: Steps when a loan crate arrives.
body: 1. Match crate stamp to loan file. 2. Photograph packing. 3. Check condition against form. 4. Assign temporary location in vault. 5. Notify curator of record.

name: Loan return checklist
summary: Steps when a loan leaves Helderwyn.
body: 1. Confirm end date. 2. Condition report. 3. Repack with original materials when possible. 4. Update accession location to 'returned'.
